controls: All four models: rotate left/right, zoom +/−, reset, close, keyboard arrows/+/-/R, GLB download
Escape closes and restores activation-button focus
Rapid close/reopen preserves working controls after prior GPU cleanup
initial: No GLB or 3D viewer/engine requested before activation
zoom: 320px with 200% text: active viewer and controls without overflow
touch: One-finger rotation and two-finger pinch zoom pass; mobile DPR=1
failure: GLB request failure handled; retry reloads and succeeds
contextLoss: Real WebGL context loss shows localized fallback; page remains usable
chunkFailure: Lazy viewer-module failure provides reload and recovers
unsupported: WebGL unavailable: fallback and close control work, portfolio remains usable
